thread:
jena (PM): Heads up — after the stakeholder sync we need to lock an actionable scope for the next milestone. Options: (A) keep MVP surface but shift some infra work to v1, (B) trim the UX/edge flows and keep infra, or (C) small timeline reset to avoid technical debt. Need quick alignment by EOD so we can update the milestone board.

sam (Eng): Can you paste the minimal list you mean by \"MVP surface\"?

jena (PM): Sure — minimal: auth, basic prompt flow, streaming, embeddings index, tenant routing. Edge flows = admin UX, bulk-import CSV, user-level quotas. Infra = autoscaling, dedicated caching, canary rollout infra.

li (Eng-ML): From model/latency POV, streaming + KV cache are non-negotiable for target SLA. If we shift caching to v1 we risk 2x token cost and 80–200ms higher p95.

omar (Design): The admin UX is currently 30% done. If we trim it now, we can ship the surface to early customers without the admin screens. But customers expecting tenant controls will notice.

kai (Product): Customer signal: Acme and BetaCo explicitly asked for tenant routing + admin controls. If we ship without admin it's a blocker for those pilots. However, they said they could wait 4 weeks if stability is better.

sam (Eng): Quick engineering run-down: autoscaling and caching are the heavy lifts (infra + runtime tests). ETA for both if we keep in MVP: ~5 weeks of focused infra + 2 sprints of reliability work. If we move caching to v1, we can ship in ~3 weeks.

jena (PM): Tradeoffs: Ship sooner (3wk) but higher ongoing cost / degraded p95 vs ship later (5wk) with better economics and pilot compliance. Any other constraints?

li (Eng-ML): Also: quantized model variant we're evaluating reduces memory pressure but needs a validation pass — adds ~6 work-days. If we accept a temporary model fallback on hosted, we can avoid that delay.

omar (Design): Suggestion: ship a trimmed admin MVP (owner-only controls) + note in onboarding that detailed admin controls are beta. That cuts UI scope but gives pilots basic functionality.

sam (Eng): Implementation plan if we go trimmed-admin + caching in v1: deliver streaming + KV passthrough (no automatic cache population), owner-only admin UI, and an explicit cost-warning in Console. Dev tasks: auth (done), streaming (wip), caching (defer), autoscale (stabilize).

jena (PM): I want a concrete proposal to present to exec: which features to cut for MVP and a one-line rationale. Kai, can you draft?

kai (Product): Draft below — feel free to edit.

Proposal for exec (to ship in 3 weeks):
- MVP includes: auth, streaming prompt flow, embeddings index, tenant routing (basic), owner-only admin controls. Rationale: ships core customer value for pilots while deferring heavy infra that delays timeline.
- Deferred to v1: autoscaling policy hardening, automatic KV caching, bulk-import UI, refined admin roles. Rationale: infra work increases SLA risk and developer time; deferring keeps timebox and allows targeted reliability work.
- Risk callouts: higher token cost and p95 if caching deferred; pilot customers might require full admin sooner.

sam (Eng): OK, engineering can commit to that 3-week plan if we triage non-blocking tech debt. Need a cutlist and owners.

jena (PM): Assignments: sam = infra lead (autoscale/caching backlog), li = model & latency validation, omar = admin MVP screens, kai = stakeholder comms & exec note. I'll own milestone board updates and release notes.

deploy-bot: draft-release created for branch/trimmed-admin-mvp by jena (PM) at 1728112265

omar (Design): One more: add a prominent in-console banner for pilot accounts: \"Admin controls beta — some features deferred to v1. Contact your CSM for details.\"

li (Eng-ML): If we accept temporary hosted-model fallback, I can finish quant validation in parallel and flip to optimized variant in v1 without rollback risk.

jena (PM): Decision (quick poll): keep full infra and slide milestone 2 weeks? or trim admin + defer caching and keep milestone? vote with emoji in thread.

sam (Eng): :thumbsup: keep milestone, trim admin + defer caching

omar (Design): :thumbsup:

li (Eng-ML): :thumbsup:

kai (Product): :thumbsup:

jena (PM): OK consensus reached. Action items: 1) update milestone board and release notes (jena), 2) create cutlist with Jira refs (sam), 3) stakeholder comms draft (kai), 4) admin banner (omar), 5) quant validation run and toggle plan (li). Expect updated milestone card by EOB today.

sam (Eng): I'll create the cutlist now: JIRA-1245, JIRA-1250, JIRA-1260.

jena (PM): Thanks — closing this thread, will post the updated milestone card shortly.
